# 16 — Milestone Map

**Version:** 0.4 (gathering ×2, 2026-10-30)
**Generated by:** `npm run sim` · **Guarded by:** `shared/test/pacing.test.ts`

## What this is
The milestones a player hits and roughly when, at **live speed (×1)**. Numbers come from a simulated *engaged* player who plays by the real rules and checks in whenever there's something to do. Typical players sleep, work and check in a few times a day, so expect roughly **1.5–2× these times**.

Re-run `npm run sim` after any change to `docs/data/`. If the pacing test fails, either re-tune or update this map on purpose.

## Philosophy
- **Players work out what to build.** Hormigas doesn't hand players a build order after the founding tasks. Figuring out the path to the next goal is part of the fun.
- **Puzzles, not invisible walls.** The game always says *what* is missing ("Needs 100 more Nectar. You don't produce Nectar yet.", "Costs 33k Foliage, but your Granary only holds 32k."), never *what to do*. Locked chambers show their requirement, and the Nest View shows the next chambers as dotted outlines.
- **Nectar is the first big goal.** The founding tasks build toward it, and discovering it unlocks castes, research and journeys beyond the nest.

## The map (engaged player, ×1)

| Phase | When | Milestone | What it opens up |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Founding** | 1 min | First chamber | The production loop |
| | 2 min | Queen's Chamber 2 | Storage, Brood Hall (needs Nectar) |
| | ~1.2 h | Queen's Chamber 3 | Aphid Pasture, Pheromone Chamber |
| | **~1.3 h** | **⭐ Nectar discovered** | Castes, research, missions — announced with a milestone report |
| | ~1.5 h | Brood Hall | Raising castes and defenses |
| | ~2.3 h | First castes, first forage | Missions, the map, the wild nest next door |
| | ~3.7 h | First raid on the wild nest, all founding tasks done | Combat, loot and corpses, learned safely |
| **Growth** | ~13 h | Major Soldiers | Real raiding power (since research pays more in Protein, 30 Oct 2026; the sim's player doesn't fight, so it gets no corpse Protein, and real players are a little faster) |
| | ~16 h | Queen's Chamber 4 | Honeypot Gallery, Excavation Works |
| | ~18 h | Honeypot Gallery | A raid shield — well before the 72 h new-colony protection ends |
| | ~33 h | Queen's Chamber 5 | |
| | ~38 h | Leaf Garden 10 | |
| **Established** | ~2.5 days | Queen's Chamber 6 | |
| | ~6 days | Leaf Garden 15 | Storage becomes a recurring planning puzzle |
| | ~20 days | Leaf Garden 20 | Long-term goals: hours-to-days per upgrade |

Since 2026-10-30 gathering is ×2 ([03-economy](03-economy.md#production)), which roughly halves the whole map: at the original pace Nectar came at ~2.4 h, Queen's Chamber 4 at ~32 h and Leaf Garden 20 at ~36 days. Build times didn't change, but the simulated player is mostly waiting for resources, not diggers, so ×2 resources is close to ×2 progress.

The sim's player saves up for 8 Minor Soldiers after scouting, to win the "Raid the wild nest" task (see [17-wild-nests](17-wild-nests.md)).

At the end of the run (~40 days) an engaged colony produces roughly 8,400 Foliage, 4,900 Protein and 1,550 Nectar per hour (2,900 / 1,450 / 520 at the original pace).

## Pacing targets (what the test enforces)
| Milestone | Target |
|---|---|
| First chamber | < 5 min |
| Queen's Chamber 2 | < 30 min |
| Nectar discovered | 1–3 h |
| Brood Hall after Nectar | < 1.5 h |
| First castes | < 6 h |
| Founding tasks complete | < 8 h |
| Honeypot Gallery | < 60 h (before protection ends at 72 h) |
| Major Soldiers | < 1.5 days |
| Queen's Chamber 4 | < 2 days |
| Leaf Garden 10 | < 4 days |

## Known gaps / next tuning questions
- The **Leaf Garden 15 → 20** stretch (~14 days at ×2, ~24 at the original pace) is steep. The dig plan (2026-10-30, [04-colony](04-colony.md#build-rules)) doesn't shorten it for this simulated player, who never leaves the diggers idle; it closes the overnight gaps real players have. If the stretch is still too slow, Excavation Works is the lever.
- Test servers (`WORLD_SPEED=5`) compress everything ~5×: Nectar in ~30 minutes.

## Open Questions
- Is ×2 gathering right for a bigger world, or only for this small playtest? Nectar at ~1.3 h answered the old "closer to 1.5 h?" question; if the game now feels rushed, `gathering.multiplier` is the one number to turn back.
